title: Find the K-th Character in String Game II
sources: https://leetcode.com/problems/find-the-k-th-character-in-string-game-ii/ (official page returns 403 to fetch; link from web search)
accessAttempt: Constraints and examples from the doocs mirror; the second example's word was checked by hand against the statement's recurrence.
summary: Starting from 'a', apply operations (0 appends a copy, 1 appends a shifted copy); return the k-th character of the final word.
officialConstraints: the final word has at least k characters
visualizationNotes: Visualization shows the operation list and the backward walk; no string is built, so the full k range is supported.
